{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_01","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_01 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. trace.raw_text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_01","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND recorded_at <= '2026-10-24T12:00:00'), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM eligible), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind='invoice' AND vendor='BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.amount_minor AS gross, MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key),0)) AS remaining FROM invoices i), unheld AS (SELECT b.*, MAX(0,b.remaining-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=b.event_key AND h.status NOT IN ('release','void')),0)) AS amount_unheld FROM balances b), priced AS (SELECT u.event_key,u.amount_unheld, COALESCE((SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=u.terms_code AND t.business_date <= u.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS discount_bps, (SELECT t.discount_until FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.event_key=u.terms_code AND t.business_date <= u.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS discount_until, (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=u.currency AND f.business_date <= u.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_num, (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=u.currency AND f.business_date <= u.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_den FROM unheld u JOIN invoices i ON i.event_key=u.event_key) SELECT SUM(CAST((amount_unheld * CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN (10000-discount_bps) ELSE 10000 END * fx_num * 2 + 10000 * fx_den) / (2 * 10000 * fx_den) AS INTEGER)) AS usd_cents FROM priced WHERE fx_num IS NOT NULL AND fx_den > 0"}}
